items.options: (a) Total stays 2,000: 35 slots from the uncommitted N-Q pool (~608 to ~573); cs -10, life -10, geography -5, Big Ideas conditional -10; Economics 165 to 200. Pilot 5 (tranche 1, ~0.6M tokens), 30 conditional (tranche 2, ~3.0M) on the DLR five, held-claim rate <=25% and a Project Review. (b) Total rises to 2,035. (c) Other cuts you name.

items.note: head-of-product, 2026-10-15 (W-897), changes the recommendation to (c): 18 slots, not 35. Under the category you chose (F-21) nothing is re-tagged from Economics, so all 40 would have to be new, and the scout found only 16-18 collision-free concepts (5 of them close calls). Recommended: pilot 5 + up to 13 conditional, from the N-Q pool (~608 to ~590); cs -8, geography -5, life -5; Economics stays 165 and Big Ideas' conditional tranche is not cut; total stays 2,000; no W-556 exemption; nothing in K-M moves. 18 is a ceiling that shrinks with the neighbours' sign-offs (fold below 12). Growing past 18 comes back to you as a new item only if a scout pass of unscouted fields yields signed clean concepts. Cost: tranche 1 stays 1.83M; tranche 2 about 1.59M (not 4.03M); about 190k per lesson because set-up is fixed. Record: company/decisions/2026-10-15-behavioral-economics-dlr-decision.md
